Hits: build each capsule in the character's CFrame from space (studs = metres * 3.571) and use workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius along a-b (or Blockcast between the previous and current a-b for the sweep). Drive events from RunService.Heartbeat with the clip fps; paired: anchor both HumanoidRootParts, set the victim CFrame = attacker CFrame * CFrame.new(lateral, 0, -fwd) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(facing), 0) at start, release at release_frame.

### Topic: 3d

3D MODELS FROM PIXEL ART (art_model -> glTF .glb, HD-2D look)
Pixel textures on low-poly meshes, NEAREST filtering, alpha MASK (BLEND for opacity/glass parts). Units = art px; export divides by scale (32 px = 1 unit). Y-up, +Z = front. Each builder's origin is bottom-centre (floor: top-centre; extrude/lathe: canvas meta.pivot). Model origin:"auto" (default) keeps part coordinates so kit pieces snap to the grid; for a standalone prop, ship or vehicle set origin:"bottom" (bbox centred on X/Z, bottom on y=0) or "center". Z-up engines (Sanctum Burn / Three.js camera.up=Z): object.rotation.x = Math.PI/2, or export {up:"z"}.
WORKFLOW: 1. Paint tileable textures first (32x32 = one grid cell; art_help topic:"textures"). 2. One model per kit piece: art_model create {name, parts:[...]}. 3. art_model preview {name} (game = 38° pitch perspective like the game camera, plus front/side/top/iso; views:["game"], size:512 for a big diorama look). 4. update {set:{0:{h:96}}} / add / remove and re-preview. 5. export {name} -> exports/<name>.glb + <name>.meta.json (bounds, triangles, units).
PARTS (every part: at:[x,y,z] px, cell:[gx,gy,gz] = x grid (32), turn:0-3 = 90° about y, rotate:[x,y,z] deg, scale, pivot:[x,y,z], mirror, array:{count, step:[x,y,z] | cell_step:[1,0,0], turn?, rotate?, about?}, opacity, glass, double_sided, hidden):
TRANSFORM ORDER: scale, then rotate X then Y then Z (fixed axes, degrees), then turn, all about the part's own origin (local 0,0,0) or about pivot:[x,y,z] (local px, e.g. a door hinge or a wing root); then at + cell*grid. mirror:"x"|"y"|"z" (or a list = every combination) also emits the copy mirrored across the model's x=0 / y=0 / z=0 plane, winding and normals fixed (image-mapped faces show the mirrored image). array copies: rotate/turn k steps about the copy's own origin, or with about:[x,y,z] (model px) about that point = radial array (engine rings, rotor blades, turret ports).
MATERIALS: opacity:0..1 (< 1 = glTF alphaMode BLEND, baseColorFactor alpha = opacity, texture alpha multiplies) and glass:true (BLEND, opacity 0.35 unless set, doubleSided, low roughness) for canopies, cockpit domes, visors, force fields. double_sided:true = doubleSided material. Translucent materials keep their own material (not atlased); engines draw them after opaque meshes without depth writes (material extras depthWrite:false), the preview blends them the same way.
- floor {w?:32,d?:32,h?:4 (top at y=0), texture|top|side|faces, broken? (eroded edges), holes?}
- wall {w?:32,h?:64,d?:8 (thickness), texture|faces{front,back,left,right,top}|side|top, broken?:{amount,step,seed}, holes?:<mask canvas>, res?:1 (outline sampling px), style?:"voxel" (blocky ruins)}
- corner {w?:32,h?:64,d?:8: L-shaped wall on the back+left cell edges}
- pillar {w?:12,h?:64,base?:4,capital?:4,flare?:2 (square)}
- column {same as pillar, round shaft (segments?:8)}
- arch {span?:16,spring?,point?:1 (1 gothic, 0.5 round),border?,w?,h?,d?:8,style?:frame|solid|ring,segments? (auto from size), broken?, holes?, voxel?}
- vault {span?:64,border?:8 (thickness),d?:32 (length),spring?:0,point?:1}
- stairs {steps?:4,rise?:8,run?:8,w?:32, tread?|riser?|side?|texture}
- ledge {w?:32,h?:4,d?:12 (box)}
- balustrade {w?:32,h?:16,d?:6,rail?:3,count?,baluster?:<profile canvas for lathe>}
- roof {w?:32 (ridge length),d?:32 (span),h?:16 (rise),style?:gable|shed, texture (slopes),side (gables)}
- rubble {w?:32,d?:32,count?:8,size?:[3,8],seed?,flatness?,tilt?}
- box {w,h,d (default texture size), texture|faces|top|side, tile?:true, broken?, holes?, taper?:s|[sx,sy] (front +z face scaled about its centre: noses), bevel?:px (chamfered edges+corners), insets?:[{face,rect,depth,texture?,side?}] (one of taper|bevel|insets)}
- wedge {w?:32,h?:16,d?:32, top_w?:w, top_d?:0 (0 = ridge), shift?:[x,z] (top centre; default flush with the back face = ramp sloping down to the front), texture|faces}
- inset {box (w,h,d,texture|faces) with one panel: face?:front|back|left|right|top|bottom, rect:[u,v,w,h] px from the face top-left as seen from outside, depth?:2 (> 0 recess, < 0 raised), panel?:<texture> (panel floor, fitted once), inset_side? (panel walls); more panels: insets:[{face,rect,depth,texture,side}]}
- cylinder {r?,h?,r_top?,r_bottom? (frustum; 0 = cone point),segments?:12,flat?,texture|side,cap|top|bottom, tile?:true, wrap?:once|repeat (once = one copy round, centred on +z; repeat = repeat?:n copies, seamless), u_offset?:0 (turns, + = toward +x)}
- cone {cylinder with r_top:0 (r = base radius)}
- prism {cylinder with segments:6 flat}
- plane {texture,w?,h? (texture size), facing?:front|up, double_sided?, tile?}
- shape {points:[[x,y],...],d?:8,plane?:xy (outline x,y; depth z centred)|xz (outline x,z; height y from 0)|zy (side profile [z,y]; thickness x centred), scale_end?:[sx,sy] + shift_end?:[x,y] + about?:[x,y] (loft: far cross-section scaled; xy far = +z front, xz = top, zy = -x), texture|faces}
- loft {shape with scale_end (default 0.5): points,d,plane?,scale_end?:[sx,sy],shift_end?,about? (default bbox centre); e.g. a hull narrowing toward the nose}
- extrude {canvas,frame?,layer?,region?,depth?:4,center?:true, depth_map?:<canvas> (luminance = thickness, voxel relief), levels?, invert?, min_depth?:1, mode?:voxel}
- lathe {canvas (right-half profile),axis?:0,segments?:12,smooth?,simplify?:0.75 px (0 = exact pixel steps),texture?,wrap?,cap?}
- tube {path:[[x,y,z],..] | from+to (+sag px = hanging cable), curve?:linear|catmull|bezier, segments?:6, r?:2, r_end? (taper), sides?:8, profile?:[[x,y],..] (custom section, x side, y up), twist? deg, caps?:true|start|end|false, closed?, up?, texture (u around x wrap?, v world px along) | trim:"sheet:strip"}
- sweep {same as tube (profile sweeps: conduits, railings, rails, hoses)}
- greeble {w?:64,d?:64 region on y=0 facing +y, seed?, density?:0.45 (0..1 covered), size?:[3,12] px, height?:[1,4], kinds?:[panel vent pipe conduit antenna bolts hatch heatsink nozzle dome cables tank block | "model:<name>"] or {kind:weight}, grid? px (snap), align?:grid|free, gap?:1, margin?:1, avoid?:<mask canvas>|[[u,v,w,h]], texture|color, dark?, accent?, textures?:{<kind>|main|dark|accent}, drop_lod?:auto (<= 2 px tall at LOD 1, else 2), instanced? (GPU instancing). On box/wall/floor/slab/ledge: greeble:{face, ...} | greebles:[..]}
- hull {length?:320,width?:96,height?:48, plan?:[[t,half_w],..] (t 0 tail .. 1 nose), profile?:[[t,top,bottom],..], sections?:[[t,section],..]|section? (exponent 2 ellipse..8 boxy | round|pill|soft_box|diamond|box|hex|wedge|keel|flat_bottom | {points:[[x,y],..] unit, chamfer?, n?, n_bottom?}), rings?, segments?:16, crease?:40 deg, interp?:smooth|linear, panel_lines?:{rings:[t..], every?:px, seams:[u..], width:1.5, depth:1, from?, to?}, plates?:[{t:[a,b], u:[a,b], lift:1.5, texture?, mirror?:true}], carve?:{mask, depth, texture?}, texture|color, groove?, plate_texture?, cap?, uv?:tile|fit (livery canvas once over the hull), caps?:true|false|nose|tail}
- truss {from+to | length,axis?:x|y|z, w?:12,h?, section?:box|tri|flat, style?:warren|pratt|x|k|none, bay?, chord?, brace?, frames?, texture|brace_texture}
- beam {from,to,s?:3 (thickness),sides?:4,caps?:true}
- revolve {profile:[[r,y],..] px, segments?:16, arc?:360, smooth?:true, wrap?, inside?:true|"only"}
- dome {r,h?:r,sphere?,rings?:4,segments?:12}
- rock {w?:64,h?:40,d?,seed?,detail?:1..3,rough?:0.25,flat_top?:0.15 (faceted boulder / outcrop for anchors)}
- wing_panel {span?:48,root?:40,tip?,sweep?,thick?:4,tip_thick?,dihedral?:0 (90 = fin),section?:hex|diamond|flat}
- catwalk {len?:96 (along z),w?:40,deck?:2,texture? (default see-through grate),rails?:both|left|right|none,rail_h?:34,post_every?:32,kick?:true}
- landing_pad {w?:192,h?:4,round?,mark?:"H"|"07",lights?:8,color?,line?,hazard?,light_color?}
- decal {kind?:text|logo|arrow|chevrons|stripes, text?, font?:3x5|5x7|7x9, px?:0.5 (model px per decal pixel), color?, color2? (stripes / second colour), bg?, dir?:left|right|up|down (arrow), count?:3 (chevrons), len? (stripes), stencil? (stencil bridges), glow? (emissive): one alpha-cut quad facing +z, place it 0.2 px off a surface}
- neon {text+font?:5x7|3x5|7x9 | canvas (1 px strokes) | strokes:[[[x,y],..]], px?:4 (model px per glyph pixel), r?:0.9, sides?:6, color, backing?:true (emissive tubes + a light marker)}
- sign {text,h?:24,w?,d?:4,color?,bg?,font?,frame?,double? (lit sign box: emissive text face)}
- holo {w?:32,h?:24,text?,color?,opacity?:0.7 (additive hologram card, double-sided)}
- fog_card {w?:48,h?:96 (hangs down from y=0),cross?:2,falloff?:radial|vertical|beam,color?,opacity?:0.35,steps?:5,dir? (additive fake volumetric)}
- god_ray {fog_card with falloff:"beam" (light shaft)}
- marker {kind:"spawn"|"door"|"nav"|...,data?:{},dir? (empty node + extras.marker)}
- container {w?:40,h?:40,d?:96,color? (corrugated cargo container)}
- model {model:"<other model>" = place another model (layouts / dioramas)}
- baked {mesh:"<name>" = a processed mesh saved by art_model boolean / remesh / decimate (stored beside the model as <name>.mesh.bin)}
- light {light for baked lighting and the game (no geometry unless bulb): kind?:point|area|spot, color?:"#ffffff", intensity?:1, range?:128 px, size?:[w,h] (area), dir?:[0,-1,0] (area / spot facing), cone?|angle?:45 deg (spot), bulb?:false|true|px (tiny emissive box), shadow?; placed like any part (at, array, mirror); also exported as node light_<n> with extras.light}
TEXTURES: texture = canvas name | "#rrggbb" | {canvas, frame?, layer?, region:[x,y,w,h], overlay:<grime canvas>}. Per face: faces:{top,bottom,front,back,left,right} or the same keys on the part; side = every vertical face; cap = top+bottom. Kit pieces get WORLD UVs after placement (1 texel = 1 px, planar per face direction, lattice origin at the grid cell edge): any offset, turn, array or nested layout continues the texture across touching pieces and courses run on around corners; tile:false fits one copy per face. three.js runtime version of the same mapping: docs/3d/README.md "World-space UVs". Emissive = a layer named "emissive" (or canvas <name>_emissive). export normal_maps:true makes/uses <canvas>_n.
ONE OBJECT, NOT PARTS (unwrap, the default): create gives every new model one UV atlas canvas <name>_uv at 1 texel = 1 px (islands unfolded with no stretch, seams on the back): the part textures baked in world-aligned (patterns run on across parts) plus contact AO, crease lines, edge wear and ground grime in clean palette bands, so the parts read as one object. update / preview / render / export re-bake it when parts or part textures change (paint is kept). Paint transitions on its "paint" layer (art_draw), or in a view: art_model unwrap {name, unwrap:{do:"view",view:"front"}} -> paint -> unwrap:{do:"project",from:"<name>_uv_front"}. unwrap:{do:"check"} = cohesion report (texel density, front seams, cut courses, missing contact shading). Options on create / update / unwrap: unwrap:{texel:1|2, max_size:256..2048, angle:46, parts|exclude, bake:{fit}, cohesion:{ao,contact,edges,grime,courses:{h,len},overlays:[{texture,where:contact|cavity|top|bottom|edges}],palette}}. Masonry: jointless stone texture + courses = joints drawn model-wide (each part = whole courses). unwrap:false = per-part textures (models saved before keep them; art_model unwrap {name} converts one). Per-part automatically, with one note: skinned models, morphs, layouts of placed models, over 6000 triangles or past max_size. Glass / opacity parts keep their own material.
RUINS: broken:true | {amount px, step px, seed} = jagged top (walls/arches) or eroded edges (floors). holes:<mask canvas> = painted pixels of the mask (stretched over the face) are cut out (cracks, breaches). Outlines are smooth polygons (marching squares + simplify; res = sampling px, default 1); style:"voxel" (arch: voxel:true) gives the old blocky look. Arch curves get segments from their size.
OVERLAYS (grime, decay, moss, blood, wear) = alpha-cut decal shells with their own UV set (glTF TEXCOORD_1, strength in COLOR_0 alpha): overlays:[{texture:"grime", where:"bottom"|"top"|"corners"|"edges"|"all" (or a list), falloff:24 px, amount:1, jitter:0.5, map:"world" (own scale, scale:1) | "face" | "piece" | "surface" (stretched 0..1), seed}] on a part or on the model (all parts). Gradients use the whole continuous surface, not one piece.
CTM (connected textures, OptiFine/Continuity style): art_model ctm {name:"marble_ctm", ctm:{base:"marble", method:"full", border:{width:2, style:"bevel"|"line", color?}}} makes a tileset canvas; texture:"marble_ctm" on floors/walls then picks a tile per world cell from its 8 neighbours across ALL pieces (same plane + same connect key: material | texture | tag via ctm_tag; walls fold around vertical corners). Methods: full (47 blob), compact (5 tiles, quarters), horizontal, vertical, horizontal+vertical, top, random (weights, variants:[canvases] or auto flips), repeat (base = cols x rows cells, one big pattern), overlay (creep tiles from overlay:<canvas>; used as overlays:[{texture:"moss_ctm", from:"grass"}]). Hand-drawn: template:<canvas> with all tiles, or the 5 compact tiles (none, all, horizontal, vertical, inner corners) -> 47. Export writes <name>.ctm.json + tileset PNGs for runtime re-tiling (ctmTileFor in docs/3d/README.md). rubble {count, size, seed} scatters chunks.
LAYOUTS / DIORAMAS: a model whose parts are {type:"model", model:"wall_a", cell:[2,0,0], turn:1}. export bakes it into one mesh (fewest draw calls), or export {instances:true} = one shared mesh per kit piece + one node per placement. atlas:true packs small image-mapped textures (and colours) into one material.
RECIPES:
- Gothic arch kit: arch {texture:"stone", span:24, point:1, spring:20, d:8} (style:"solid" = door/window panel; style:"ring" = rib); vault {texture:"stone", span:64, d:32}; pillar/column between arches at cell edges; broken:{seed:3} for the ruined variant.
- Floor + walls: floor {texture:"tile", array:{count:4, cell_step:[1,0,0]}}; wall {texture:"brick", at:[0,0,-12], top:"cap_stone"}; corner for room corners; ledge/balustrade along edges; stairs {steps:4, rise:8, run:8, tread:"tile"}.
- HD-2D prop: extrude {canvas:"barrel", depth:6} (front/back = the sprite, sides = edge pixel colours).
- Gargoyle / carved relief: draw the gargoyle + a grayscale height canvas (light = thick), extrude {canvas:"gargoyle", depth_map:"gargoyle_h", depth:8, levels:4}.
- Lathed candle / urn / baluster / bell: draw the RIGHT HALF of the silhouette from x=0 (axis) on a canvas, lathe {canvas:"candle", segments:12}; flame pixels on an "emissive" layer glow.
- Chain: extrude a link sprite and alternate it: {type:"extrude", canvas:"link", depth:2, array:{count:6, step:[0,-6,0], rotate:[0,90,0]}}.
- Marble floor groups: ctm {name:"marble_ctm", ctm:{base:"marble", method:"full", border:{width:2}}}; floors {texture:"marble_ctm", cell:[..]}: one bevelled border around each connected group, none on the seams. Separate rooms: ctm_tag:"hall" vs "chapel" with ctm:{connect:"tag"}.
- Gothic stone walls: wall {texture:"stone"} runs at any offset (world UVs keep the bricks continuous); base trim = ctm {name:"trim_h", ctm:{base:"trim", method:"horizontal"}} on a ledge row (end caps only where the run stops); random {weights:[6,1,1]} for occasional cracked blocks.
- Spaceship hull: loft {points:[[-12,0],[12,0],[10,10],[-10,10]], d:64, scale_end:[0.3,0.4]} (narrows toward the +z nose), wings = wedge {w:40, h:3, d:24, top_w:8, shift:[16,0], at:[14,2,0], mirror:"x"}, nose cone {type:"cone", r:6, h:12, rotate:[90,0,0], at:[0,5,32]}, engines = cylinder {r_bottom:5, r_top:4, h:10, rotate:[-90,0,0], at:[10,5,-32], mirror:"x"}, canopy box {w:10, h:6, d:14, bevel:2, glass:true, color:"#9fd8ff", at:[0,10,12]}, intakes/hatches = box insets:[{face:"front", rect:[4,2,8,4], depth:3}] (recess) or depth:-1 (raised panel), hangar mouth = an inset touching the bottom edge. Side profile of a fuselage: shape {plane:"zy", points:[[z,y],...], d:<width>}. Export with origin:"bottom".
- Radial engine ring: cylinder {r:3, h:6, at:[16,0,0], array:{count:6, rotate:[0,60,0], about:[0,0,0]}}. Hinged door: box {w:16, h:24, d:2, rotate:[0,-70,0], pivot:[-8,0,0]}. Decal on a fuel tank: cylinder {side:"tank_decal", wrap:"once", u_offset:0.25} (image centre faces +x; u_offset in turns), wrap:"repeat" (repeat:n) = seamless repeats.
- Moss + grime: overlays:[{texture:"grime", where:["bottom","corners"], falloff:20}, {texture:"moss", where:"top", falloff:10}, {texture:"wear", where:"edges", falloff:3}].
Keep it light: kit pieces < 500 tris, few textures shared by many pieces.
HARD-SURFACE DETAIL (ships, stations, carrier interiors, cities at a pixel-texture budget):
- PBR: part material:"painted_metal"|"bare_metal"|"rubber"|"plastic"|"glass"|"emissive_panel"|"fabric" or {metal:0..1, rough:0..1, preset?} -> glTF metallicFactor / roughnessFactor (default stays metal 0, rough 1). Canvas-wide: art_canvas meta {material:"bare_metal"}. Per texel: layers named "metal" and "rough" on the texture canvas (grey = value, unpainted = the factor) -> metallicRoughnessTexture (G rough, B metal), never part of the colour. glass = the glass:true material; emissive_panel glows with its own colour when the canvas has no emissive layer. atlas:true merges PBR textures into one metallicRoughness atlas.
- Height + normals: a layer named "height" (white = high) makes a pixel-correct normal map: no blur, only texels within bevel texels of a drop to a lower neighbour tilt (the high side gets the chamfer), tiles wrap seamlessly; glTF convention (green = up). bump:<strength> | {strength:1 (texels of height per full step, 1 = 45° rims), bevel:1..8, auto:"luminance"|"panels" (derive height from brightness steps or from dark panel lines when there is no height source), levels, threshold, invert} on a part, on the canvas meta, or export/preview {bump} for every canvas with a height source (height layer or a same-size <canvas>_h canvas). The preview lights normal maps, metalness and roughness per pixel.
- Greebles: {type:"greeble", w:96, d:64, seed:3, density:0.45, size:[3,12], height:[1,4], kinds:["panel","vent","pipe","conduit","antenna","bolts","hatch","heatsink","nozzle","dome","cables","tank","block"] | {vent:3, pipe:1}, grid:4 (snap to the panel grid), align:"grid"|"free", gap:1, margin:1, avoid:<mask canvas> | [[u,v,w,h]], texture, dark, accent, textures:{vent:"..."}, drop_lod:"auto" (pieces <= 2 px tall drop at LOD 1, taller at LOD 2) | n, instanced:false} scatters non-overlapping pieces on the y = 0 plane facing +y (seeded: same seed = same pieces). On box / wall / floor / slab / ledge: greebles:[{face:"top"|"front"|..., ...}] scatters over that face (top-left as seen from outside, like insets). Your own pieces: kinds:["model:my_vent"] or create a model with greeble_kind:"my_vent" and use kinds:["my_vent"] (fitted to the footprint). Pieces merge into the model mesh (same materials = same draw calls); instanced:true exports one mesh per distinct piece + EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing nodes (three.js GLTFLoader -> InstancedMesh). LOD export drops greebles from drop_lod on.
- Sweeps: {type:"tube"|"sweep", path:[[x,y,z],...], curve:"linear"|"catmull"|"bezier" (3n+1 points), segments:6, r:2, r_end?, sides:8, profile?:[[x,y],...] (custom section: x side, y up; rectangles = conduits / rails), twist?, caps:true|"start"|"end"|false, closed?, up?, texture (u around, wrap:n; v = world px along) | trim:"sheet:strip"}. Hanging cable: {type:"tube", from:[x,y,z], to:[x,y,z], sag:10, r:0.5, sides:4}. Polyline corners are mitred, frames never flip.
- Trim sheets: art_model trim {canvas:"hull_trim"} paints a 64-wide sci-fi sheet (strips plate, bevel, bolts, seam, hazard, grate, rib, pipe, rubber, light, plate_dark with height, metal, rough and emissive layers; strips:[{name, style, h, base?, accent?, glow?}], colors:{base, light, dark, accent, glow}); art_model trim {canvas:"my_sheet", strips:{edge:[0,8], seam:[8,4]}} marks a hand-painted one ([y, h] rows). Parts: trim:"hull_trim:bevel" | {sheet, strip, faces:"auto"|"edges"|"all", scale, flip, max}: auto = bevel chamfers + inset walls + faces thinner than the strip; u runs along the face at world scale (seamless along a run), v spans the strip. Tubes map the strip around the section. Ship hulls and interiors share one texture.
- Mesh ops: boolean:"subtract"|"union"|"intersect" on a part cuts / joins its target (target: part index, id:"name" or name; default the previous part); the cutter is not emitted; results stay closed and manifold (T-junctions split), world UVs continue on the cut walls; pieces away from the cutter (greebles) keep their triangles. Model merge:true | {weld:0.01, internal:true} welds near vertices and drops hidden faces between touching pieces. Model morphs:{open:{set:{door:{rotate:[0,-90,0]}}}, damaged:{model:"hull_damaged"}} (door = part index or id:"door"; a part name makes it a rig node, and rigs cannot morph yet) -> glTF morph targets (mesh.extras.targetNames, weights 0); a morph may move, turn or resize parts, not change segment counts; preview {morph:{open:1}}.
- Shadows: part cast_shadow:false / receive_shadow:false -> separate nodes with extras {cast_shadow, receive_shadow} (rig nodes carry their part's flags).
- Materials v2 (art_help {topic:"materials"}): clearcoat / anisotropy / transmission / sheen / subsurface / emissive strength, detail + height (POM) maps, displacement, light parts, lightmaps + SH probes, ORM packing, export profiles three / roblox / minimal, art_model material editor, preview {channel}.
RENDER COST (export options; preview {ao, lod, morph} shows them):
- bake_ao:true | {mode:"texture" (AO lightmap: occlusionTexture + TEXCOORD_1, one NEAREST chart per face, texel:2 px) | "vertex" (COLOR_0) | "both", samples:24, distance:24 px, strength:1, levels?} ray-casts hemispheres against the model (BVH): contact shadows in crevices, under greebles, in insets. Deterministic (same input = same bytes). Each LOD level bakes against itself into one shared lightmap.
- lods:[1, 0.5, 0.2] (lod_mode:"nodes" (default: <name>_lods > <name>_LOD0..n, extras.distance) | "files" (<name>_lod1.glb, ...), lod_screen:{height:720, fov:70, px:1}): quadric edge collapse onto existing vertices that keeps every triangle's own UVs (flat regions stay pixel-exact), material borders and open borders, drops hidden faces between pieces, greebles from drop_lod, overlays from LOD 1. meta.lods.levels[i].distance = where that level's error falls under px screen pixels (three.js: lod.addLevel(node, node.userData.distance)).
- rigged models (named parts / sockets / clips): lods keep the rig (each rig node keeps LOD0 and gets hidden children <node>_LOD1..n in its frame, so clips still move them; root extras.lod_levels, meta.lods.mode "rig"); bake_ao / lightmap / thickness bake on the rest pose (every piece at its rest placement occludes the others) and ride with the parts. Skinned models: see skinning (LODs skinned on skin 0, bake on the bind pose).
- impostor:true | {layout:"octahedral" (grid:8, hemi; full:true = whole sphere) | "ring" (angles:8|16, pitch), size:64 px per cell}: <name>.impostor.png (albedo, unlit) + _n (world normal) + _d (depth) + .impostor.json (cells: rect, dir; encode formula; quad size; switch_distance) for far LOD billboards.
- collision:"hull" (convex hull, <= ~124 tris) | "boxes" | {type, max_boxes:16, cell, hull_points:64}; occluder:"boxes" (conservative: inside the surface) | "hull": nodes <name>_collision / <name>_occluder (extras {collision|occluder, visible:false}; boxes listed in meta for physics). Not counted in triangles.
- stats:true: meta.parts_stats per part (triangles, bounds in units, greebles, GPU instances); also written with lods / impostor / collision.
- cull:{rooms:[{name, min:[x,y,z], max:[x,y,z]} | {name, cells:[[gx,gy,gz],[gx,gy,gz]]}], portals?:[{rooms:[a,b], min, max}], depth:2} on a layout model (or export {cull}): one node room_<name> per room (+ room_outside), doorways found automatically where two room boxes touch (open samples on the shared wall), meta.cull {rooms, portals, pvs}. Engine: find the camera's room, draw it + pvs[room] (or walk portals through the frustum). Browser budget: hero ship sections 3-8k tris at LOD0, kit pieces < 1k, GPU-instance repeated greebles, impostors past a few hundred units.
MESH PROCESSING (art_model actions; units = model units (m), results saved as a new model out (default <name>_<op>) with one baked part {type:"baked", mesh} stored as <models>/<out>.mesh.bin, so preview / export / lods work on it; preview:true adds a wireframe render):
- boolean {name, op:"union"|"subtract"|"intersect", with:"<other model>", out?} (exact predicates on a symbolic intersection graph: closed, manifold, deterministic; a 140k-triangle kitbash unions in ~2.5 s). Without with: union of every shell of the model into ONE closed hull, hidden interior faces removed (kitbashed ships). Part booleans switch to the same path above 4000 triangles (boolean_method:"auto"|"robust"|"bsp" on the cutter part).
- remesh {name, method:"voxel", voxel?:0.1 (m) | resolution?:64 (cells on the longest side), sharp?:true, simplify?:true}: winding-number occupancy (copes with self-intersecting / non-manifold soups and greeble piles), dual contouring with sharp features, then a 0.25-voxel-bounded simplify; UVs, materials and colours transferred by closest point. -> watertight manifold shell.
- remesh {name, method:"quad", faces?:<target>, feature_angle?:40, symmetry?:"x"|"y"|"z"|{axis, at}}: quad-dominant retopology (feature edges kept, relaxed on the source, quads paired by quality; stats.quad_ratio). method:"cleanup" = weld + degenerates + consistent winding + small holes (holes:16 edges).
- decimate {name, ratio?|triangles?|max_error? (m: guaranteed bound, measured Hausdorff reported), feature_angle?:45, seams?:true}: half-edge QEM keeping UV seams, material borders, open borders, feature/silhouette edges, normals, vertex colours and skin (JOINTS/WEIGHTS) intact.
- cluster_lod {name, path?, cluster_size?:128, group_size?:4, levels?:4, max_part_tris?:20000, lod_screen?, visibility?, distances?:[m,..] (preview at those camera distances)}: Nanite-style cluster DAG (128-tri clusters with bounds sphere + normal cone; groups simplified with locked borders, error monotonic up the DAG) -> <name>_lod.clod sidecar (format: docs/meshproc/README.md) + <name>_lod.glb with discrete LODs cut from the DAG (<name>_lods > <name>_LOD<i> > _p<k> parts of <= max_part_tris: one Roblox MeshPart each; extras.distance for THREE.LOD) + <name>_lod.meta.json. Runtime selector: src/clodselect.js (pure JS: parseClod, selectClusters(camera) -> crack-free cut + frustum and cone culling).
- visibility {name, path?, cells?:[{name, min, max}] (m) | model cull.rooms | parts tagged room:"<name>", step?, depth?, occluder?:{voxel, max_boxes}|false} -> <name>.vis.json: cells, portals found by ray probes through openings, PVS, conservative occluder boxes. cluster_lod {visibility:true} puts the same block (+ cluster_cell) in the .clod JSON.
HARD-SURFACE RECIPES:
- Hull greebling: box {w:96, h:24, d:64, texture:"hull", material:"painted_metal", bevel:2, trim:"hull_trim:bevel"} + box {w:96, h:24, d:64, greebles:[{face:"top", seed:3, grid:4, density:0.5, avoid:[[40,0,16,64]]}, {face:"right", seed:4, kinds:["vent","pipe","bolts"], size:[2,6]}]} (or a greeble part on a hull face), a hatch = box {boolean:"subtract", target:"hull"} + an inset panel; export {bake_ao:true, lods:[1,0.5,0.2]}.
- Carrier corridor module (one trim sheet): art_model trim {canvas:"corr_trim"}; floor {texture:"deck", trim:{sheet:"corr_trim", strip:"grate", faces:"all"}}; walls box {w:64, h:48, d:4, insets:[{face:"front", rect:[4,6,56,36], depth:1}], trim:"corr_trim:bevel"}; light strip box {h:2, trim:{sheet:"corr_trim", strip:"light", faces:"all"}}; pipe runs tube {path:[..], trim:"corr_trim:pipe"}; ribs = box {array:{count:4, step:[0,0,32]}, trim:"corr_trim:rib"}; export {bake_ao:true, collision:"boxes"}.
- Pipe run: tube {path:[[0,40,0],[0,40,64],[32,40,64],[32,8,64]], r:2, sides:8, trim:"hull_trim:pipe"} + clamps box {w:6, h:6, d:2, array:{count:3, step:[0,0,24]}} + a sagging cable tube {from:[0,44,0], to:[0,44,64], sag:6, r:0.6, sides:4}.
- City block LOD + impostor: a layout model of building models, export {lods:[1,0.5,0.15], impostor:{grid:8, size:64}, occluder:"boxes"}: LOD0 near, LOD1/2 by meta.lods distances, the impostor billboard past impostor.switch_distance, occluder boxes for occlusion culling.
SHIPS + STRUCTURES (ship construction kit, interiors, industrial / city kits, neon, light helpers, layout generators):
- hull {length, width, height, plan:[[t,half_w],..], profile:[[t,top,bottom],..], sections:[[t,section],..]} lofts a closed hull from design curves (t 0 = tail, 1 = nose; monotone cubic, interp:"linear" for straight runs). Sections: exponent (2 ellipse .. 8 boxy) | round|pill|soft_box|diamond|box|hex|wedge|keel|flat_bottom | {points:[[x,y],..] unit square, chamfer}: polygon corners stay hard creases, crease:40 deg sets which edges smooth. Relief (no CSG, stays closed): panel_lines:{rings:[t..]|every:px, seams:[u..] (u 0 top centre, 0.25 +x side, 0.5 keel; mirrored), width, depth} grooves; plates:[{t:[a,b], u:[a,b], lift}] raised armour / plate layers; carve:{mask:<canvas>, depth} recesses (or raises, depth < 0) the hull quads under the mask's opaque pixels (x = around, y = nose..tail). uv:"fit" maps one livery canvas over the whole hull.
- on_hull:{hull:"<hull id|name>", t, u, lift?, mirror?} on any part or assembly: placed on the surface, local +Y = surface normal, +Z = toward the nose (mirror adds the 1-u copy, name suffix _m).
- Assemblies (one part -> several parts, own at/rotate/scale applies to all). Named (name:"gear_l") = rig nodes "<name>", "<name>.<piece>" + clips (same-named clips of several assemblies merge: every leg in gear_retract); unnamed = static in the given state (open:0..1, deployed:false):
  canopy {len?:48,w?:22,h?:12,ribs?:3,hinge?:rear|front,open_angle?:65,open?:0..1 (static),frame|glass textures,opacity? -> clip canopy_open (named)}
  engine {r?:10,len?:40 (axis z, nozzle toward -z),nozzle_len?,petals?:10 (exhaust petals; petal_flare?:10 deg),straps?:true,glow?:"#7fd8ff",textures:{housing,nozzle,dark},segments?:12 -> plume socket / marker <id>_plume, glow light}
  thruster {r?:3,len? (small nozzle block, nozzle toward -z),glow? -> plume marker}
  wing {span?:64,root?:48,tip?,sweep?,thick?:4,dihedral?,side?:both|left|right|center,root_x?:0,section?:hex|diamond|flat,fold_angle?:90 (named: clip wings_fold; static fold:0..1),vtol?:true (+ pods, clip vtol_down),nav_lights?:true}
  fin {wing with side:"center", dihedral:90 (vertical stabiliser)}
  landing_gear {h?:24 (strut length down from the mount),r?:1.6,foot?:pad|wheel|skid,retract?:back|forward,bay?:true,door_w?,door_d?,textures:{texture,piston,door,dark} -> named: clips gear_retract + gear_deploy (merged over every leg), socket <name>_contact; static deployed?:true|false (false = closed bay doors)}
  ramp {w?:48,len?:56 (panel height when closed, hinge at its bottom edge, outer face -z),thick?:3,open_angle?:112,open?:0..1 (static),textures:{texture,tread,hazard} -> named: clip ramp_open; door marker for interiors}
  cargo_door {w?:40,d?:48 (panel in the local xz plane facing +y: put it on_hull),thick?:2,style?:slide|gullwing|split,open?:0..1 (static),open_angle? -> named: clip <name>_open; door marker}
  turret {r?:8,h?:5,style?:cannon|rotary,barrels?:2 (rotary 6),barrel_len?,barrel_r?,scan?:60,textures:{texture,dark,barrel} -> named: yaw node <name>, pitch <name>.pitch, clips <name>_scan (+ <name>_spin), socket <name>_muzzle}
  rotary_cannon {turret with style:"rotary" (6 barrels, spin clip)}
  hardpoint {len?:24 (pylon under the mount, -y),payload?:true (missile),missile_r?:2 -> hardpoint_<id> socket / marker}
  antenna {h?:24,style?:whip|mast|array|blade (red beacon light on whip / mast)}
  sensor_dome {r?:6 (sensor dome on a base ring, small status light)}
  rcs_quad {s?:4 (RCS block with 4 nozzles in the tangent plane; rcs markers for puff sprites)}
  intake {w?:16,h?:8,d?:20,depth? (air scoop facing +z: lipped mouth, deep dark duct, splitter, compressor face, grille slats)}
  vent {w?:12,d?:16,slats?:5,glow?:<colour> (heat glow under the slats)}
  armor_plate {w?:20,d?:28,h?:1.8,steps?:2 (stepped: a smaller second layer),bolts?:true (bevelled armour plate in the local xz plane: put it on_hull)}
  container_rack {cols?:2,rows?:2,layers?:1 (along z),size?:[40,40,96] px per container,gap?:3,fill?:1 (seeded share present),colors?:[..],seed?,frame?:true (stacking frame of beams)}
  corridor {kind?:straight|L|T|X|end (open sides: n always; L adds e, T adds e+w, X all), len?:1 (cells, straight/end; 64 px = 2 m wide, 96 px = 3 m tall: player metrics), h?:96, textures:{floor,wall,ceiling,rib,pipe,grate}, light_color?, openings? (override per side)}
  room {cells?:[cw,cd] (64 px cells),h?:96,openings?:{n|s|e|w:"open"|[{at, kind:door|window|open, w?, h?, sill?}]},textures:{floor,wall,ceiling,rib,glass},ribs?,lights?,pipes?,light_color?}
  door {style?:bulkhead (2 sliding leaves)|blast (heavy, rises)|hatch (round, swings),w?:40,h?:76,thick?,open?:0..1 (static) -> named: clip <name>_open; door marker; sits in a wall gap (plane xy, facing +z)}
  airlock {1-cell airlock: inner bulkhead (s) + outer blast door (n), red cycle light; named: doors <name>_inner / <name>_outer with their open clips}
  ladder {h?:100,w?:16,grab?:true (rails + 0.3 m rungs in the xy plane, rails run 1 m past the top as grab bars; ladder marker + trigger for climbing)}
  lift {w?:56,d?:56,travel?:100 (one deck),textures:{frame,floor,rail} -> named: platform node, clip <name>_up}
  seat {pilot / crew seat facing +z, player-sized (seat pan 0.5 m, headrest 1.45 m); seat marker (socket for the seated player, canopy head clearance in walk_check)}
  console {w?:56,screens?:2,textures:{texture,screen (emissive UI canvas; default a glowing colour)},screen_color? -> screen markers <id>_mfd<i> (size for UI textures), sockets when named}
  bridge {bridge / cockpit: room (default 3x2 cells) + consoles with MFD screen markers, seats, a holo table; openings for the canopy / windows (n)}
  engine_room {engine room (default 3x3 cells, h 160): reactor core (emissive column in a glass sleeve, cage, caps), conduits, glowing feed lines, catwalk ring + ladder, strong core light, glow fog card; core_r?, core_color?}
  quarters {crew quarters (2x2): bunks, lockers}
  cargo_bay {cargo bay (3x4, h 128): containers, floor hazard lines, overhead crane rails + bridge beam}
  hangar {hangar (6x6, h 224): pad with markings, roof trusses, light shafts}
  med_bay {med bay (2x3): beds, scanner arch (emissive), cabinet}
  armoury {armoury (2x2): weapon racks, ammo crate}
  tower {h?:320,w?:32,style?:lattice|solid,platforms?:2,beacon?:true}
  dish {r?:64,depth?,tilt?:35,mount_h?, textures:{texture,mount} (parabolic comms dish; named: clip <name>_track)}
  tank {r?:40,h?:96,style?:cylinder|sphere|capsule,legs?:4,bands?:2,ladder?:true,textures:{texture,band}}
  silo {r?:48,h?:240 (silo with cone roof, ladder, catwalk, beacon)}
  crane {h?:240,boom?:200 (tower crane: lattice mast, jib, counterweight, cab, hook cable; named: clip <name>_slew)}
  gantry {span?:192,h?:128,trolley?:0 (gantry: two lattice legs + beam + trolley)}
  pipeline {path:[[x,y,z],..],r?:6,supports?:64 px,curve? (pipe + support legs + flanges)}
  scaffold {w?:96,d?:32,h?:192,levels?:3 (scaffold: posts, x-braced faces, grated decks with rails)}
  ladder_cage {ladder alias}
  hangar_shell {w?:384,d?:512,h?:192,thick?:8,segments?:10 (arched hangar shell open at both ends, ribs, door light bar)}
  hab_module {len?:192,r?:48,window? (colony habitat module: cylinder on legs, window bands, airlock porch)}
  rock_platform {w?:256,d?:192,h?:96,seed?,open?:[sides without rails] (deck anchored on a rock outcrop by struts)}
  shaft {r?:256,depth?:768,levels?:3,sides?:16,walk_w?:48 (vertical city shaft: inward wall, ring walkways with rails, level lights, light shaft)}
  atrium {w?:384,d?:384,h?:480,levels?:3,balcony?:48 (rectangular atrium well with balcony levels)}
  bridge_walk {len?:192,w?:40 (walkway bridge: grated deck over a truss)}
  lift_shaft {h?:480,w?:64,ride? (open lattice lift shaft with a hanging cage on a cable; named: cage node, clip <name>_ride)}
  cable_web {from,to,count?:6,sag?:24,spread?:32,seed?,lamps?:0 (sagging cable bundle between two anchors; lamps hang from it)}
  pipe_wall {w?:128,h?:96,count?:6,seed? (backing wall with vertical / bent pipes and valves)}
  market_stall {w?:64,d?:48,h?:72,awning?,sign?:<text>|false,neon?,sign_color?,lamp?,seed? (stall facing +z: counter, posts, awning, crates, lamp, neon or lit sign)}
  sign_frame {text,style?:neon|box|blade,w?,h?,color?,px?,hang?:<px> (hanging cables up to a ceiling) (bracket + neon tube text / lit sign box / vertical blade sign)}
  gun_pod {len?:64,r?:7,barrels?:6,barrel_len? (gun pod under its mount (-y): pylon, lofted pod, ammo chute, rotary barrel cluster with clamp rings, muzzle toward +z; named: clip <name>_spin, socket <name>_muzzle)}
  fairing {len?:96,w?:24,h?:10 (wing-root / pylon fairing along z on the mount plane y = 0)}
  hinge {len?:32,r?:3,count?:4 (exposed hinge knuckles along x with a through pin: wing folds, ramp / door hinges)}
  stair_run {h?:100 (rise),w?:48,max_rise?:6.4 (0.2 m),going?:9.6 (0.3 m tread) (straight stair run up along +z with stringers and handrails; walk marker kind stairs)}
  crate {size?:24,h?,color?,yaw? (supply crate, kit_crate texture tinted)}
  barrel {size?:18 (diameter; 1.4x tall),color? (drum with hoops and a hazard label)}
  stool {bar stool (0.7 m)}
  chair {chair facing +z}
  terminal {small?:false (counter top) | floor kiosk; screen?:<UI canvas> (kit_screen); screen marker}
  figure {h?:57.6 (1.8 m at 32 px/m),pose?:stand|seated,color? (scale figure for renders)}
  glazing {hull:<hull id>, t:[t0,t1], u:[u0,u1] (same as the hull opening it fills), cols?:4, rows?:2, inset?:3 px, mullion?:5 px, frame?:8 px, opacity?:0.32, textures:{glass, frame} (glass panes set into the armour + heavy mullion grid)}
  ring_door {r?:38 (opening radius px: 2.4 m door),open?:0..1 (static),open_angle?:105,glow? (round airlock door in the local xz plane facing +y, local +x = up: square adapter plate with a round cut, collar, lit ring, leaf with concentric rings, hub + locking bars, exposed hinge; named: clip <name>_open; door marker + trigger)}
  screen_arm {reach?:18,w?:14,h?:10,angle?:35,tilt?:-10,yaw?,textures:{texture,screen} (articulated screen arm; the screen faces -z toward the user; screen marker)}
  pilot_seat {pilot seat facing +z (player-sized): pedestal, perforated leather (kit_leather), armrest pods with joysticks and lit button tops, articulated screen arms both sides; seat marker}
  locker_wall {kind:weapon_rack|storage|component, w?:64, h?:72, d?:10, y?:4, label?, slots? (weapon_rack), cols? (storage), covers?:[names] (component), glow? (wall module centred on z = 0 facing +z: framed recess, gun slots with status lights / numbered locker doors / labelled covers, lit header + label decal)}
  portal_arch {w?:72,h?:84 (clear opening, >= 1.4 x 2.3 m),chamfer?:16,frame?:8,d?:8 (chamfered octagonal bulkhead portal, open at the floor, light bar on the head, hazard jambs)}
- Templates: create {name, template:"fighter"|"dropship"|"hauler"|"capital_ring", seed, length?, textures?:"kit"|{hull, hull2, dark, metal, glass, glow, hazard}, rigged?:true (false = one static mesh: canopy:"open", gear:"up", ramp:"open"), livery?:<canvas>}: a complete ORIGINAL ship (gear contact at y=0, +Z nose) to refine with set:{<part name>:{..}} / add / remove.
- art_model kit {prefix?:"kit", colors?, seed?} paints the kit canvases (kit_hull, kit_hull_dark, kit_metal, kit_metal_dark, kit_deck, kit_wall (light strip), kit_hazard, kit_accent, kit_glow, kit_glass, kit_screen (MFD UI, emissive), kit_rock, kit_concrete, kit_pipe, kit_scratches (wear overlay)) with height / metal / rough / emissive layers + the kit_trim sheet. All nearest-filtered pixel textures.
- art_model livery {name:<ship>, canvas?, primary, secondary, belly?:0.3, stripes:[{t:[a,b], color, u?}], hazard:[{t, u}], decals:[{text, t, side:left|right|top|bottom, v?, size?, color}], mark:{t, side, seed, color} (seeded original emblem), wear?:0.35, panel?:24 px, apply?:true}: paint masks + stencils + scratches on a canvas mapped once over the hull (applied as texture + uv:"fit"; decals read correctly from outside).
- art_model generate {kind:"interior", name, hull:<ship model>, part?, seed?, deck_h?:96, cell?:64, doors?:"open"|"closed", windows?:true, textures?}: a deck plan fitted inside the hull (rooms on a corridor spine: bridge at the nose, engine room, side rooms, cargo bay at a rear ramp), doors where the exterior ramp / hatches are, windows written back onto the ship (iwin_* parts), cull rooms for portal culling; report: rooms, doors, alignment (gap px per exterior hatch). kind:"mining_colony" {seed, platforms?:4} | "market" {seed, length?, width?, height?, bridges?, zones?}: seeded layouts of instanced kit models (<name>_k_*), walkable floors in the report, light markers, haze; export {instances:true, collision:"boxes"}.
- Neon + signs: neon {text, font:"5x7", px, color} (emissive tube strokes from the pixel font or a canvas of 1 px lines), sign {text} (lit box), holo {text} (additive card), sign_frame. Light helpers: light {color, intensity, range:128, kind:point|spot|area, bulb?} -> node light_<n> + a baked-lighting light with extras.light (place real lights sparingly); fog_card / god_ray = crossed additive planes with banded soft falloff (fake volumetrics). marker {kind} = any spawn / nav / door point (extras.marker).
- WALKABLE SHIPS (true scale, 32 px = 1 m; one model holds exterior + interior). Player metrics (walk.js PLAYER_M): capsule 1.8 m tall, r 0.35 m, eye 1.65 m; doors >= 1.2 x 2.1 m; corridors >= 1.4 x 2.3 m; stairs <= 0.2 m rise, <= 38 deg (ladder when steeper); slopes <= 35 deg; ramps <= 20 deg; hull >= 0.15 m thick at openings; seats clear a seated head (1.38 m). Sizes: snub 10-14 m, fighter 18-24 m, dropship 30-40 m, hauler 80-120 m, corvette 150 m+, capital 500 m+.
- hull shell:<px> = inner skin (wall thickness) + openings:[{t:[a,b], u:[a,b] (u0 > u1 wraps the top), id}] cut through both skins with rims that show the thickness; tag interior parts inside:"<hull id>" so walk_check tests the fit. glazing {hull, t, u, cols, rows, inset:3, mullion:5, frame:8} fills an opening with glass set into the armour + heavy mullions. ring_door {r:38, name?} = round airlock (concentric rings, lit ring, hub, exposed hinge; local +x = up, rotate:[0,0,90] mounts it on a -x wall). Interior kit: portal_arch (chamfered octagonal bulkhead portal), locker_wall {kind:weapon_rack|storage|component} (lit header, labels), screen_arm, pilot_seat (armrest pods, joysticks, screen arms, perforated kit_leather), terminal, stair_run {h} (risers <= 0.2 m), crate, barrel, stool, chair; gun_pod (rotary barrel cluster), fairing, hinge (exposed knuckles); figure (1.8 m scale silhouette for renders). Walk data rides on markers: walk {w, d, room, kind, headroom} areas (rooms, corridors, catwalks, ramps, stairs add theirs), ladder, lift, door, collider, trigger, seat, spawn.
- art_model walk_check {name} -> ok, problems, blocked_doors, headroom (and seat head clearance), unreachable areas (from spawn markers / the ground, through doors, ladders, lifts and open edges), floor_gaps, hull_pokes (interior parts outside the inner skin), metrics (door / corridor sizes, slopes, stair rise, hull thickness); positions in metres. Doors, ramps, canopies and airlocks are opened for the test. export {walk:true} adds <name>_walk (navmesh, extras.navmesh, proxy), collider_<n> (box colliders per room), trigger_<n> (door / ladder / lift volumes), seat_<n> and spawn_<n> nodes; without walk those markers stay out.
- template:"gunship" = the hero: an ORIGINAL 25 m VTOL gunship (maker ORVANE, class TERN) with a walkable interior (corridor with portal arches, grating, blue edge strips, weapon rack / storage / component bay, airlock vestibule, hold, cockpit with pilot seat behind the mullioned glazing); rigged nodes hull > boom_l/r > pod_l/r, airlock, chin_turret, gear_*; clips vtol, airlock_open, gear_retract/deploy; pose landed; static: rigged:false + vtol:"flight", gear:"up", airlock:"open". generate {kind:"interior", merge:true (default)} also writes the deck plan into the ship (inside:<hull>).
- Kit textures without canvases: any texture "kit_<name>" or "kit_<name>_<rrggbb>" (tinted) resolves to the built-in painted pixel texture (height -> normal map, metal / rough) when no canvas has that name: hull, armor, hull_dark, accent, metal, metal_dark, deck (tread plate), grate (see-through), wall, panel_light, ceiling, slab (one bevelled armour slab per face, tile:false: worn edges), hazard, rust, concrete, rock, pipe, fabric, crate, barrel, container, container_end, rubber, leather (perforated), glow, glass, screen, scratches + grime (overlays). Kit pieces and templates use them by default (textures:"flat" on templates = flat colours). decal {kind:text|logo|arrow|chevrons|stripes, text, px:0.5, color, bg, glow} = stencils, serials, labels, arrows, warning chevrons (alpha-cut quad facing +z; never occludes AO).
- Previews: mood:true lights every surface per pixel (normal maps, specular highlights of the point lights, baked AO with ao:true, key + fill + rim light); mood {rim:false|{color, strength}, fill, key, max_lights:12, gain, ambient, sky:true|{top, horizon, ground, horizon_y} (vertical sky / ground gradient behind the model)}. Preview only: exports are unchanged.
- Budgets: art_model budget {name, class?} -> class (snub 6k, fighter 14k, dropship 45k, freighter 80k, corvette 120k, capital 200k (exterior + walkable interior), prop 1.5k, kit_piece 3k, room 8k, building 25k, district 150k), triangles, LOD estimate, draw calls, costliest parts, advice. export {budget:"fighter"} fails over budget; split:true (or a count) splits meshes over 20000 triangles (Roblox MeshPart limit) into <mesh>_part<k> child nodes; static:true|"<pose>" bakes a rigged ship's pose so lods / impostor / cull apply (sockets -> marker nodes).
- Previews: preview {mood:true | {ambient, ambient_color, key:{dir, color, strength}, gain, bg}} = dark scene lit by the model's own light markers (engines, neon, lamps) as coloured point lights; additive cards add light.
RIGS & CLIPS (rigid parts, PSX / Half-Life 1 style, no skinning; also maps to Roblox: one MeshPart per node + Motor6D):
- name:"bolt" makes a part its own glTF node (own mesh); parent:"receiver" nests it (child transforms are local to the parent). pivot:[x,y,z] (part-local px) = the JOINT: the node origin, what poses rotate about. Unnamed parts merge into the root mesh, or into their named parent's mesh (parent:"receiver" on an unnamed grip). rig:{merge:false} = every part its own node (auto names type_i). create/info report rig.tree, nodes (joint px, triangles), sockets, poses, clips.
- sockets:{muzzle:{part:"barrel", at:[x,y,z] (model px, rest pose, same space as part at), look?:[0,0,-1]}, sight:{part:"optic", at, look}, grip_r, grip_l, mag_well} -> empty child nodes socket_<name> (local -Z = look; omit part to hang it on the model root). Games: put socket_sight on screen centre for ADS, spawn the muzzle flash at socket_muzzle, hands on socket_grip_r / socket_grip_l.
- pose {name, pose:"cant", parts:{receiver:{rot:[0,0,-20], at:[dx,dy,dz], scale?}}, base?:<pose>}: offsets from the rest pose per node. at = px in the PARENT's frame (a magazine at:[0,-8,0] drops out of its receiver even when the receiver is tilted); rot = degrees X then Y then Z in the node's rest frame, about its joint.
- animate {name, clip:"reload_empty", keys:[{t:0, pose:"rest"}, {t:0.65, parts:{magazine:{at:[0,-9,1]}}, ease:"smooth"}, ...], loop?, duration?, ease?, events?:[{t:0.65, name:"mag_out"}]}: t in seconds (strictly increasing); a key = pose and/or parts (parts override the pose per node). ease on a key = the motion INTO it: linear (default) | smooth | step; clip-level ease = the default for every key. loop with duration past the last key closes back on the first key. keys:null deletes a clip (pose {parts:null} deletes a pose). Export writes one glTF animation per clip: channels per moved node (translation / rotation quaternions / scale); all-linear -> LINEAR at the key times, all-step -> STEP, otherwise baked at 30 fps. Events go in the animation's extras.events (sounds, shell ejects). Rotations interpolate the short way (slerp): split turns over 180° with an extra key.
- preview {name, pose} (views:["side","fp"]) or {name, clip, frames:6, view:"side"|"fp"|"iso"|{pos,look,fov}} = contact sheet with the time under each frame: check a reload by eye. view "fp" = first-person camera at the model origin looking down -Z, 60° vertical fov.
- Props (doors, chests, turrets, levers): the same named parts + pivot + pose + clip, e.g. a lid {name:"lid", parent:"base", pivot:[0,0,-5]} and pose {parts:{lid:{rot:[-105,0,0]}}}; skill prop-rig.
- export meta.json rig.nodes = parent-space translation (units) + rotation per node: Roblox Motor6D Part0 = parent, Part1 = node, C0 = CFrame(translation) * rotation.
TEMPLATES (view space: origin = the eye, -Z forward, +Y up, 32 px = 1 m; override anything with textures:{..}, set:{<part name>:{..}}, add, remove:[names], poses/clips/sockets:{name: value|null}):
- template:"fp_arms": clavicle_r/l > upper_arm_r/l > forearm_r/l > hand_r/l > fingers_r/l (+ thumb_r/l), slots textures:{sleeve, cuff, glove}; poses rest, grip_rifle, grip_pistol (palms on the fp_rifle / fp_pistol grip sockets); clip idle_breathe.
- template:"fp_rifle": receiver > barrel, handguard, stock, magazine, bolt, charging_handle, optic, trigger; sockets muzzle, sight, grip_r, grip_l, mag_well; poses fire_kick, bolt_locked, reload_tilt; clips fire (bolt cycle), reload_tactical, reload_empty (magazine out + in, charging handle). Slots {metal, polymer, magazine, optic, lens}.
- template:"fp_pistol": frame > slide, barrel, magazine, trigger; same sockets; poses fire_kick, slide_locked, reload_tilt; clips fire (slide cycle), reload. Slots {metal, slide, polymer, magazine}.
FIRST-PERSON WEAPON EXAMPLE (true 3D, .glb):
1. art_model create {name:"ar", template:"fp_rifle", textures:{metal:"gun_metal", polymer:"gun_poly"}, set:{magazine:{h:5}}} (texture canvases are ordinary pixel art and must exist first; a slot also takes a colour).
2. art_model create {name:"arms", template:"fp_arms", textures:{sleeve:"sleeve_camo", glove:"glove"}}.
3. art_model pose {name:"ar", pose:"inspect", parts:{receiver:{rot:[0,25,-30], at:[-2,2,-2]}}}; animate {name:"ar", clip:"inspect", keys:[{t:0, pose:"rest"}, {t:0.6, pose:"inspect", ease:"smooth"}, {t:1.6, pose:"inspect"}, {t:2.2, pose:"rest", ease:"smooth"}]}.
4. preview {name:"ar", clip:"reload_empty", frames:8, view:"side"}; preview {name:"arms", pose:"grip_rifle", views:["fp","side"]}.
5. export {name:"ar"} and {name:"arms"}: parent both to the camera in-engine; play "reload_empty" on the gun and a matching arms clip; socket_sight on screen centre for ADS.
PRE-RENDERED SPRITES (the PS1 / Doom technique: build low-poly, render to pixel sprites; arms as a separate layer):
- render {name, canvas, pose? | clip?, frames? (or fps, default 15), angles?:[{yaw,pitch,roll}] | sweep:{yaw:[-20,20,5], pitch:[-10,10,5], roll?}, camera?:"fp" (default) | "side" | "front" | "iso" | "top" | "game" | {pos,look,fov}, size:[w,h], light?:{dir:[x,y,z] (model axes, pointing TOWARD the light: +y up, +x right, +z toward the front camera; default [-0.5,0.8,0.45] = upper left front), color, ambient}, outline?:"#1a1a1a", quantize?:{colors:16 | ["#hex",..] | palette:"project" (needs the model in a project), dither:true}, only?/hide?:[part names], animation? (tag; default the clip / pose name, or "angles"), zoom? (screen px per model px; the "game" camera too, at the model centre), fov? (also "game"), duration? (ms per frame), parts? (inline pose)}: one frame per clip sample (or per angle; sweeps are row-major: pitch rows x yaw columns, tag "angles"), nearest texels, no anti-aliasing, transparent background, tagged as an animation on the canvas. Angles rotate the model about its origin (pivot:[x,y,z] to change). The camera is fitted to the FULL model for every frame, so layers rendered with only/hide stack exactly. Size defaults to [64,64], max 1024; max 400 frames per render. Limitation: the fp camera (and close {pos} cameras) DROP triangles crossing the near plane instead of clipping them, so a part reaching behind the eye (a long stock, a shoulder) can vanish in some frames: shorten or move it forward, or render camera:"side".
- Anchors: every frame stores each socket's screen position and screen rotation (forward axis) in meta.anchors[animation][frame] = {socket_grip_r:[x, y, rot], socket_grip_l, socket_muzzle, socket_sight, socket_mag_well}; art_animation spritesheet json writes them per frame (frames[].anchors; json:false strips them).
- Guns held by arms (3D weapon handling): create {template:"fp_rifle", weapon:true | {attach:["vertical_grip"|"angled_grip"|"bipod"|"suppressor"], carry?}} (fp_pistol: weapon:true). weapon.grips names the grips (socket names or {part, at, look?, up?}): grip_main (default socket grip_r), grip_support (grip_l), stock, muzzle, optic (sight), mag; weapon.frames:{grip_main:{look, up}} = knuckle direction and back of the hand on each grip. Carry states (view space, about the trigger grip): hip, aim (optic on the eye line), ready_low, ready_high, sprint, reload (support hand on the magazine through the clip), holster | pistol: aim, compressed, low, reload, holster; states:{name:{base, rot:[x,y,z], at:[x,y,z], lock?, fire?}} adds your own. render {name:"arms", hold:{weapon:"ar", carry:"aim", clip?:"reload_empty", both?:true, fix?}} solves both arms onto the grips every frame (two-bone IK, wrist oriented to the grip, reach: support slides back then the gun moves back; dead zone: head / chest / shoulders, pushed forward then out; muzzle down outside firing states). render {name:"ar", hold:{arms:"arms", carry}} renders the gun carried the same way (layers line up). animate {name:"arms", clip, hold:{weapon:"ar", clip?, carry?, fps?, bake_weapon?:"<clip>"}} bakes a held arms clip (and the carried gun clip) for glTF export. check {name:"arms", hold:{weapon:"ar"}, clips?, carries?} validates every clip x carry state: hand-to-grip, reach, penetration, muzzle, on-screen share and arm occlusion.
- Arms that follow the gun: a 2D arm rig (art_rig) uses those anchors as per-frame IK targets: art_rig animate {name:"arms2d", animation:"reload", canvas:"arms_reload", ik_from:{canvas:"ar_reload", animation:"reload_empty", map:{hand_f:{anchor:"socket_grip_r", bend:-1}, hand_b:"socket_grip_l"}, offset?:[dx,dy]}, keys?}: same frame count and timing as the gun clip (give the arm rig the same frame size as the render, or offset:[dx,dy]), the hands land on the grips in every frame (map value "<anchor>" or {anchor, bend?, rot?:true (anchor rotation, + rot_offset) | deg, at?:[dx,dy], weight?}). End parts are your rig's hands: hand_f / hand_b on humanoid templates, or your own names (a minimal arms rig: frame = render size, root [80,119], body > upper_r > fore_r > hand_r and body > upper_l > fore_l > hand_l, see skill fp-weapon).
PRE-RENDERED FP WEAPON EXAMPLE: 1. create {name:"ar", template:"fp_rifle", textures:{..}} 2. render {name:"ar", canvas:"ar_reload", clip:"reload_empty", fps:12, size:[160,120], camera:"fp", hide:["magazine"], quantize:{colors:16, dither:true}, outline:"#14141a"} (gun layer) 3. render {name:"ar", canvas:"ar_reload_mag", clip:"reload_empty", fps:12, size:[160,120], camera:"fp", only:["magazine"]} (magazine layer, same anchors) 4. render {name:"ar", canvas:"ar_sway", sweep:{yaw:[-6,6,3], pitch:[-4,4,2]}, size:[160,120]} (sway / turn frames) 5. art_rig create a 2D arms rig with frame [160,120] and draw its parts, then animate {..., ik_from:{canvas:"ar_reload", animation:"reload_empty", map:{hand_r:"socket_grip_r", hand_l:"socket_grip_l"}}} 6. paint over any frame by hand, then art_animation export {canvas:"ar_reload", format:"spritesheet"} for each layer (json frames[].anchors line the layers up in-engine).
SKINNING (true skeletal deformation: mechs, exosuits, creatures, hoses, cables, flags, landing gear, 3D source characters for sprites):
- skeleton {name, skeleton:{template:"humanoid"|"exosuit"|"quadruped"|"chain"|"landing_gear", fit?:true (scale to the model height), height?, count?/from?/to? (chain)} | {from_parts:true} (bones = named rigid parts, joint = pivot) | {library:"<art_anim skeleton>", height?} (bones from the 2D rest pose: side view = depth, front = width) | {bones:{<name>:{parent?, head:[x,y,z] model px, tail?, rotate?, limits?:{x?|y?|z?:[min,max] deg}}}}, ik?:{<chain>:{bones:[root,..,end], pole?:[x,y,z]}}, constraints?:[{type:"aim"|"look_at"|"copy_rotation", bone, target:<bone>|[x,y,z]|<key target>, axis?, up?, from? (copy), weight?}], sockets?:{<name>:{bone, at, look?}}, cable?:{r, sides, texture, segments} (chain helper: a tube swept through the joints + heat weights)}. Humanoid / exosuit bones use the humanoid_hd names (pelvis torso chest neck head, upper_arm/forearm/hand_f|b, thigh/shin/foot_f|b; _f = right -X, _b = left +X; faces +Z), so 2D and 3D share clips. skeleton:null removes skeleton + skin.
- skin {name, skin:{method:"heat" (diffusion along bones, default) | "distance" (falloff?:6) | "rigid" (each part 100% to its bone: part bone:"x", rigid:{<part>:<bone>}, its name, else nearest; blend?:px = blended seams), parts?:[parts that get the method; others rigid], smooth?:2, exclude?:[bones], subdivide?:0..3, paint?:[{bone, weight, mode?:"set"|"add"|"smooth", region:{box|sphere:[x,y,z,r]|part|below|above|all} | canvas:<weight canvas> (luminance; view front|side|top)}], shapes?:{<name>:{sculpt:[{sphere|box|part, move?:[dx,dy,dz], inflate?:px, scale?}]} | {set:{<part>:{..}}} | {model}, driver?:{bone, axis:"x"|"y"|"z", from:0, to:90} (corrective: weight follows the joint angle)}}: <= 4 influences, normalised. weights {name, bone?} = weights_check (unweighted, > 4 before pruning, non-normalised) + heat map.
- pose {name, pose, bones:{<bone>:{rot, at, scale}}}; animate {name, clip, keys:[{t, bones|pose, morphs?:{<shape>:w}, ik?:{<chain>:{target:[x,y,z]|{bone, at}, weight?}}, targets?:{<name>:[x,y,z]}, ease?:linear|smooth|step|in|out}], loop?, events?, plant?:true|{chains, ground, threshold} (feet held on the ground by IK)} or animate {name, clip, retarget:{skeleton:"<art_anim skeleton>", clip?, map?:{<2D part>:<bone>}, scale?}} (2D side-view rotations -> rotations about X, root translation scaled by leg length). IK, plants, constraints and drivers are baked per frame.
- preview {name, clip|pose|bones, frames?, view?}; render {name, clip, sweep:{yaw:[0,315,45]}, quantize, outline} = 8-direction pixel sprites from one 3D body (socket anchors per frame).
- export: glTF skin (joints, inverseBindMatrices), JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0, shapes as morph targets on the skinned primitives, animations with TRS + weights channels, validated (structural). profile:"roblox" (max_bones?:50 assumed per MeshPart, r15?:true = R15 bone names): splits the mesh so each skin has <= max_bones joints, names [A-Za-z0-9_], morphs dropped. Materials v2 apply to skinned exports too (material presets / extensions, packing, tangents, vertex_colors, profile three | roblox | minimal). lods:[1,0.5,0.2] adds <name>_mesh_LOD1..n, each a skinned mesh on skin 0 (weights carried through the decimation by surface transfer from the bind mesh; meta skin.lods); bake_ao / lightmap / thickness bake on the bind (rest) pose (TEXCOORD_1). Roblox profile + lods: refused (Roblox makes MeshPart LODs itself). impostor / atlas / instances are not available on skinned models yet.

### Topic: materials

MATERIALS V2 (art_model): everything a modern renderer needs, at a pixel texture budget
Opt-in per part, canvas or model; a model that uses none of it exports the same bytes as before. Full three.js hookups: docs/materials/README.md.
SPEC (part material, canvas meta.material, or a model material): preset or {preset?, metal, rough, emissive, clearcoat, anisotropy, transmission, ior, sheen, subsurface, height, detail}.
- New presets: painted_hull (clearcoat 1, rough 0.12), brushed_metal (anisotropy 0.8, streaked map), glass_canopy (transmission 0.95 + volume + ior 1.5, opaque, not BLEND), cloth (sheen), neon (emissive strength 6), skin (subsurface). The 0.7 presets are unchanged.
- emissive:{color?:"#ff40a0", strength?:6, animate?:"flicker"|"pulse"|"strobe"|"sputter" | {mode, hz, min, max, seed, duty}} -> KHR_materials_emissive_strength; with color the "emissive" layer becomes a grey MASK (emissiveTexture) tinted by emissiveFactor = color; no layer = the whole surface glows; animate -> material extras.emissiveAnimation (formula in the docs).
- clearcoat:{factor:1, rough:0.1} (painted hulls); anisotropy:{strength:0.8, rotation:deg, pattern:"brushed"|"flat"|"radial"} (brushed / spun metal: anisotropyTexture, TANGENT always written); transmission:{factor:1, ior:1.5, thickness:px, attenuation:{color, distance:px}} (+ KHR_materials_volume / ior); sheen:{color, rough} (fabric); subsurface:{factor, color} -> KHR_materials_diffuse_transmission (+ extras.thicknessTexture when export thickness:true).
- height:{scale:2 px, bias:0} -> extras.heightTexture (grey, scale/bias in units, uv_per_unit) for parallax occlusion mapping (pixel-snapped POM shader in the docs); profile three exports it for every texture with a height source.
- detail:{texture:"<tiling canvas>", normal?:"<canvas>", scale:4 (detail texels per base texel), strength:0.5} -> extras.detail {texture, normal, scale, strength, uv_scale}: crisp close-ups of big hull surfaces.
- Canvas layers: "metal", "rough", "height" (0.7) and "ao" (material occlusion, ORM red; else cavity from height).
UNWRAP ATLAS (default for new models): metal / rough / height / emissive of the part textures are baked into hidden layers of <name>_uv (edit them like any canvas); bake_ao / lightmap still use TEXCOORD_1; AO is already in the atlas colour, so use bake_ao strength 0.5 or none.
EDITOR: art_model material {name} lists presets, model materials and every texture's channels; material {name, material:"hull", preset:"painted_hull", set:{clearcoat:{factor:0.8}}} creates / edits (null removes a field, false switches a preset's field off), delete:true removes. Parts use it with material:"hull"; a model material named like a canvas applies to that canvas's faces on parts without a material. preview {name, channel:"lit"|"albedo"|"normal"|"world_normal"|"tangent"|"orm"|"metal"|"rough"|"ao"|"emissive"|"height"|"lightmap"|"bent"|"thickness"|"uv1"|"detail"|"clearcoat"|"sheen"|"transmission"|"anisotropy"|"subsurface" | [list] | "all", pom?:true, bake?:true} = channel breakdown (bake channels run a quick bake).
GEOMETRY: part displace:true | {scale:2 px, bias:0, max_triangles:2000, tolerance:0.25 px, min_texels:1, seams:"lock"|"open"} = true displacement from the height map: adaptive longest-edge subdivision where the height is not flat, crack-free, region borders locked (watertight boxes, tiling terrain). paint:"#rrggbb[aa]" + wetness:0..1 feed vertex colour sets.
LIGHTS: {type:"light", kind:"point"|"spot"|"area", at, color, intensity:1, range:128 px, size:[w,h] (area), dir:[0,-1,0], cone:45} = markers for baking (no geometry unless bulb:true|px; array / mirror like any part); each also exports as node light_<n> (extras.light) and lights mood previews.
EXPORT (art_model export):
- profile:"three" = everything: TANGENT, ORM packing, texture dedupe, height textures, all extensions. "roblox" = SurfaceAppearance: <name>.roblox/<material>_color|normal|metalness|roughness.png (<= 1024 px, nearest-upscaled: Roblox filters bilinearly) + surface_appearance.json, meshes < 20k triangles (simplified when over), everything else dropped and reported. "minimal" = geometry + base colour.
- packing:"gltf_orm" (one ORM texture shared by occlusionTexture and metallicRoughnessTexture) | "roblox" | "unity_mask" (extras.unityMaskTexture: R metal, G occlusion, B detail mask, A smoothness). tangents:true (MikkTSpace-compatible TANGENT wherever a normal map is present).
- lightmap:true | {texel:4 px, padding:2, samples:32, bounce:1, direct:true, sun:{dir, color, intensity:1} | false, sky:{color, ground, intensity:0.5} | false, levels:32, dither:true, range:2, emissive:1}: coloured lightmap on TEXCOORD_1 (shared charts with bake_ao), sun + sky + light parts + emissive surfaces + bounce, quantised + Bayer-dithered -> material extras.lightMap {index, texCoord 1, intensity}. direct:false keeps the sun / lights dynamic.
- probes:true | {spacing:px, samples:128, max:512}: SH9 radiance probes on a grid (meta.probes or <name>.probes.json, three.js SphericalHarmonics3 order) for sprites / characters inside baked spaces.
- bake_ao:{bent:true} adds an object-space bent-normal map (extras.bentNormalTexture); thickness:true bakes SSS thickness for subsurface materials.
- vertex_colors:true | {color0:"paint"|"masks"|"ao"|"height", color1}, uv2 / uv3:"world"|"box"|"lightmap"|"uv0" (consecutive TEXCOORD_n; meta.vertex_data says which).
Every v2 export runs the in-repo structural glTF validator (result materials_v2.valid).
RECIPES: painted hull panel = box {texture:"hull" (height/metal/rough layers), material:"painted_hull"}; brushed part = material:"brushed_metal"; canopy = material:"glass_canopy"; seat = material:"cloth"; neon sign = canvas with an emissive layer + material:{preset:"neon", emissive:{color:"#ff40a0", strength:8, animate:"flicker"}}; lit corridor = light parts + export {profile:"three", lightmap:{sun:false}, probes:true, bake_ao:true}.

### Topic: damage

DAMAGE + DESTRUCTION (art_model damage / fracture, art_draw damage)

STATES: art_model damage {name, states:["scuffed","damaged","wrecked"] | [{name, amount:0..1, seed?, regions?:[<part> | {parts?, at:[x,y,z] px, r?:16, amount?}], features?:{dents|panels|bend|glass|scorch|scratches|wear|bullets|wires|breach|emissive: weight 0..3}}], kind?, seed?:1, rigid?:{<part>:0..1}, roles?:{panels|glass|screens|lights|bend|leaf|breach|keep:[parts]}, inner?:"#23262c", frame?:"#555a63", sparks?:true, palette?:{soot,scorch,scorch2,hole,ring,scratch,wear,crack:"#rrggbb"}} stores the states on the model and replies with a contact sheet (intact + each state) and per-state features / fx sockets. Presets: scuffed 0.25, damaged 0.6, wrecked 1. delete:true removes them. Export: art_model export {name} writes <name>.damage.glb (every state as a node); damage:{mode:"files"} writes one <name>_<state>.glb per state (EXPORT section).
One seeded feature set per model: every feature has an onset amount, so scuffed is inside damaged is inside wrecked (same seed). Features:
- dents / crumples: impacts on the surface, edge-consistent subdivision (crack-free) + displacement with falloff, scaled by 1 - rigidity (glass 1, screens 0.8, default 0.25; rigid:{part:1} never dents).
- panels: thin plates (or roles.panels) hinge out (offset) or come off (lost): an inner backing + frame ribs + exposed wiring (sweeps) with spark sockets and small emissive sparks at the wire ends (sparks:false = none). Smaller parts inside a moving or lost panel / door leaf (windows, stripes, bolts) ride along with it.
- bend: long thin parts (antennas, rails, nozzles, pipes) bend from their base; steam socket at the tip.
- glass: cracks (decal) then a jagged shard hole growing with the amount (kind "glass": the pane shatters to the frame).
- screens / lights (emissive faces): cracked, then dead (emissive off, darkened); lights flicker first (fx_flicker socket) then die.
- breach (hull / engine, or wrecked on the biggest part): BSP subtract of a jagged prism (through thin plates, a pocket in thick hulls) with inside-material walls, curled rim petals, exposed ribs and cables. An open host (a capless duct, a plate of separate faces) is closed first (the cleanup hole fill, features.closed_hosts) so the cut is a real boolean; close:false keeps it open (the cut then stays a decal-only opening).
- surface decals (pixel-art palette, ordered dither): scorch + soot plumes, scratches, edge wear on sharp edges (tinted from the base texture), bullet-hole clusters, glass / screen cracks. A per-face chart atlas (1 texel = 1 px) under an overlay shell.
Kinds tune the weights: door (leaf jammed at damaged, blown out at wrecked; roles.leaf), terminal / console (smashed screens, sparks), crate / barrel (burst: outward bulges, lid / sides off, barrel leak socket), glass (pane shatters), light (flicker -> broken), hull (breach + leak), engine (bent nozzles, fire / smoke / steam).
FX SOCKETS: fx_spark_n, fx_smoke_n, fx_fire_n, fx_steam_n, fx_leak_n, fx_flicker_n per state (position px, direction = emit along, intensity 0..1).
LOOK: preview {name, damage:"wrecked"} = one state; render {name, damage:"damaged", canvas, camera, size} = sprite frames of a damaged prop.

FRACTURE: art_model fracture {name, groups:[{part:<name|id|index>, pieces?:8 (2-64), method?:"voronoi"|"slice", seed?, inside?:<texture>, debris?:0 (that many of the biggest chunks split into 3 more), density?:600 kg/m^3, group?, parent?:<group>, boolean?:"auto"|"bsp"|"robust" (auto = BSP for small parts, the robust BVH path of art_model boolean above 4000 triangles)}]} = pre-fractured breakables: each chunk = BSP intersect of the closed part with a convex cell (watertight, volumes sum to the part), interior faces in the inside material. Reply: chunks, volume error, watertight, mass + an exploded view in chunk colours. A part of several touching closed shells (column = plinth + shaft + capital) is united first so chunks stay manifold (reply merged_shells). Open parts (no caps, holes) are closed first: close?:"auto" (default: cleanup hole fill, then a voxel remesh) | "cleanup" | false (refuse open parts); the reply / manifest records closed {method, before, after}. Budget: sum over groups of (pieces + 3 x debris) x part triangles <= 250000. Skinned models: damage states and fracture (the chunks are rigid; in the damage export each top chunk rides the bone weighing most on its surface: extras.bone, manifest chunk.bone). Big parts: robust booleans / voxel remesh (mesh-processing) can replace the BSP later.

EXPORT: art_model export {name} on a model with damage / fracture writes the usual <name>.glb (unchanged) plus:
- <name>.damage.glb: root <name>_damage > <name>_intact, <name>_<state> (extras.damage_state, amount, visible; fx socket children <name>_<state>_fx_<kind>_<n>, -Z = emit direction), <name>_fracture > <name>_<group> > <name>_<chunk> (origin = centre of mass, extras.mass_kg, child *_collision convex hull, hidden) > debris.
- lods:[1,0.5,0.2] (or damage.lods): every state gets <name>_<state>_LOD0..n children (decals kept on LOD1). The blend-ready intact mesh keeps its chart UVs, damage RGBA and dent morph on every level, so the blend works at any distance.
- rigs: a model with named parts / sockets / clips keeps them in every state: <name>_<state>_rig (or _LODn) holds one node per rig node (<prefix>_<node>, rest TRS, its piece of the damaged mesh: a door, a turret, a hatch stays its own node), socket nodes, and one animation per clip drives the matching nodes of every state (a damaged door still opens). Manifest rig {nodes, sockets, clips, validation}.
- skinned models: every state is a skinned mesh on the one armature (skin 0): the intact state keeps the bind weights, damaged states take the weights of the closest point on the bind surface (manifest skin.weight_transfer_max_px). LODs: every level skinned on skin 0 (weights transferred onto the decimated mesh). Roblox profile: no morph targets, <= 4 influences, <= max_bones (50) joints per MeshPart (meshes over it split into <node>_partN with their own skins over the same bones; manifest skin.roblox), <= 20k tris. bake_ao / lightmap / thickness bake on the bind (rest) pose.
- every rigged / skinned damage glb passes both glTF validators (structure + skins / animations) before it is written.
- masks: the intact node is blend-ready: chart UVs on the first free UV set (TEXCOORD_1, or after the AO / lightmap set and uv2 / uv3 when the export bakes bake_ao / lightmap / thickness or adds uv2 / uv3: manifest blend.uv_set, node extras.blend.uv_set), morph target "damage" (dents; the intact overlay shells carry the same morph so decals stay on the dented surface) and <name>.damage_mask.png (RGBA = scorch, dent, holes, wear; threshold encoding: a texel is damaged once blend >= 1 - value/255) so one 0..1 blend lerps intact -> wrecked on one mesh. damage:{vertex:true} adds the same 4 channels per vertex (_DAMAGE attribute; vertex:"color" = COLOR_0). mask_channels:true writes the channels as greyscale PNGs. texel?:1 (model px per mask texel, 0.05..64) + max_size?:1024 (16..2048) size the mask atlas.
- damage:{mode:"files"} = <name>_<state>.glb + <name>_fracture.glb; mode:"blend" = only <name>.blend.glb (intact + masks). damage:false skips it all.
- damage:{profile:"roblox"} = <name>.damage.roblox.glb: states + chunks as separate MeshParts (<= 20k triangles, simplified when over), masks / morphs / UV2 dropped, decals baked into colour.
- <name>.damage.json manifest: states (nodes, triangles, lods, sockets in units), blend (mask file, channels, encoding), fracture groups (chunks with volume, mass, centre, bounds, collision, parent / level), usage notes.
MATERIALS V2: the mask channels are meant to drive material blends (scorch -> roughness up / albedo down, wear -> metal up, holes -> alpha cut, dent -> normal strength) next to paint / wetness masks; until then the mask is a side file on TEXCOORD_1.

SPRITES: art_draw damage {amount, seed, kinds?:[scratches,dents,holes,cracks,scorch], on?:[plate colours], palette?, mirror?, region?} paints damage onto existing pixel art using only palette colours; same seed = same relative spots in every frame / view (armour plates, helmets, 2D props).

### Topic: audio

AUDIO (art_audio): SFX, instruments, songs, analysis you can SEE and READ (you cannot hear).
LOOP: create (sfx/song) -> analyze (image + listener report) -> critique (ranked issues + fixes) -> edit the definition -> re-render -> export.
SFX: art_audio {action:"sfx", recipe:"gib_burst", seed:1, variants:3, vars:{pitch:0 (semitones), length:1, intensity:0.6, variation:0.5, wet:0.7, reverb?}} -> assets gib_burst_1..3. Recipes:
  gore: gib_burst flesh_squelch bone_crunch blood_splat dismember arterial_spray
  combat: hit_light hit_heavy crit whip_crack blade_swing crossbow_shot censer_whoosh explosion fire_burst
  holy: bell_toll choir_hit chant_swell
  ui: click hover confirm level_up
  monster: monster_growl boss_roar
  firearms: gunshot_rifle gunshot_pistol gunshot_revolver gunshot_marksman gunshot_shotgun gunshot_smg gunshot_lmg gunshot_suppressed
  firearms_synth: gunshot_rifle_synth gunshot_pistol_synth gunshot_marksman_synth gunshot_shotgun_synth gunshot_smg_synth gunshot_lmg_synth gunshot_suppressed_synth
  weapon_handling: mag_out mag_in bolt_rack dry_fire shotgun_pump casing_drop
  scifi: laser_bolt plasma_shot shield_hit glitch_tear teleport_swell servo drone_rotor hologram_ui alarm_klaxon radio_squelch_on radio_squelch_off bullet_whiz ricochet
  movement: footstep
  steam: steam_hiss steam_vent steam_leak
  sfxr: sfxr_pickup sfxr_laser sfxr_explosion sfxr_powerup sfxr_hit sfxr_jump sfxr_blip
  sfxr: {params:{wave:"square|saw|sine|noise", freq:0.3, slide:-0.2, attack, sustain, punch, decay, lpf_freq, hpf_freq, vib_strength, arp_mod, repeat_speed, phaser_offset, duty...}} (sfxr ranges 0..1 / -1..1).
  Custom layers: {layers:[{kind:"voice"|"note"|"sfxr"|"crackle"|"drops"|"squelch"|"growl"|"whoosh"|"glide"|"glitch"|"sample"|"recipe", at:s, gain:dB, pan, ...}], fx:[...], reverb:{preset, wet}}.
  SFX are trimmed (no head silence), faded and normalised to peak -1 dBFS (target:-3 for UI).
FPS / SCI-FI SFX (firearms, weapon_handling, scifi, movement groups above):
  Firearms gunshot_rifle|pistol|revolver|marksman|shotgun|smg|lmg|suppressed are real recordings (CC0 field recordings of AR-15 / AK-47, Walther PPQ, S&W 642, Tikka / Springfield .30-06, Mosin 7.62x54R, 12-gauge pumps, Swedish K / PPSh; suppressed = a recorded shot without its blast + the action clack): the seed picks the shot (variants are different real shots, played at the recorded pitch), vars.pitch (semitones) / length / intensity shape it, vars.distance "near" (default) | "far" (the distant recording), vars.environment "outdoor" (as recorded, real tail) | "indoor" (room) | "canyon" (long repeating echoes), vars.wet scales the added tail; gunshot_suppressed vars.caliber "pistol"|"rifle".
  The synthesized originals stay as gunshot_rifle_synth|pistol_synth|marksman_synth|shotgun_synth|smg_synth|lmg_synth|suppressed_synth (crack, body, thump, sub, mechanics; environment outdoor = slapback, marksman = long slapback).
  Handling: mag_out mag_in bolt_rack dry_fire shotgun_pump casing_drop (vars.surface "metal"|"concrete"). footstep vars.surface "metal"|"dirt"|"concrete"|"snow"|"grate".
  Sci-fi: laser_bolt plasma_shot shield_hit glitch_tear teleport_swell servo drone_rotor hologram_ui alarm_klaxon radio_squelch_on radio_squelch_off bullet_whiz ricochet. drone_rotor and alarm_klaxon are loops by default (loop:false = one-shot).
  Steam (art_fx steam): steam_hiss (one-shot burst: a valve opening, a pipe bursting), steam_vent (steady roar, loop), steam_leak (thin sputtering jet, loop); the loops are seamless by default.
  Example: {action:"sfx", recipe:"gunshot_rifle", variants:4, vars:{environment:"canyon", intensity:0.8}}.
SFX OPTIONS (recipes and custom layers alike):
  fx:[{type:"dc"|"eq"|"comp"|"drive"|"delay"|...}] runs on the mixed layers (also "dc", ["dc","comp"] or {comp:{ratio:4}}). reverb:{preset:"room"|"studio"|"hall"|"plate"|"crypt"|"cathedral", wet:0.3} | "hall" | false. target:-3 or vars.target = peak dBFS. tail:s = padding for delay/reverb tails.
  loop:true | {length:s, crossfade:s} = seamless loop: the end crossfades (equal power) into the start and export writes loop points (WAV smpl, OGG tags).
  Layer kinds also: sample {sample:"guns/rifle_1" (bundled: guns/<pistol|revolver|smg|rifle|marksman|lmg|shotgun>_1..3 and _far) | "C:/sfx/shot.wav" (your own .wav, stereo is mixed to mono) | [several] (the seed picks one), pitch semitones, start s, dur s} plays a recording; glide {wave|noise:true, pts:[[t,hz],...] or f, dur, a, r, decay, env:"swell", am:{rate,depth}, vib:{rate,depth cents}, lp, bp, q, track} and glitch {dur, density, f}.
  note/voice layers without instrument/patch use a plain triangle tone; pitch_env/amp/filter/vibrato set on the layer override the patch. pitch_env.amount = start offset in semitones gliding back to the note: positive falls, negative rises; shape:"linear" sweeps evenly over time.
  sfxr layers are DC-blocked (20 Hz high-pass) when they carry an offset; dc:false keeps the raw output.
  info {name} on a recipe asset shows resolved:{layers, fx, reverb, target}: send them back as {layers, fx, reverb, seed} to reproduce and edit the sound. delete {name:"pew_*"} takes wildcards.
